purpose: Answering profile, rendering intent, CMYK, gamut and Lab questions with formvis's own colour service.

should_trigger.prompt: Which rendering intent should I use to convert this sRGB logo to FOGRA39 for print?
What does pure sRGB red become in CMYK with the profile formvis ships?
Is the colour 20, 120, 200 inside the gamut of the FOGRA39L Coated profile?
How big is the delta E between two blues in formvis's colour service?
What is the difference between perceptual and relative colorimetric in formvis Convert to Profile?
How does the Gamut Warning decide a colour is out of gamut?
What profiles does formvis list and which CMYK profile is the default?
Why does a CMYK profile fail when I ask the lut route to convert to it?

should_not_trigger.prompt: Make this photo warmer and a bit brighter.
Add a Halftone filter to formvis.
Export this picture as a JPEG on my Desktop.
Fix the flicker in the layers panel.
Pick a nice colour palette for my website.
Calibrate my monitor with a colorimeter.
Bump the version and write the release notes.
Remove the background from this product photo.
